grade_reason: Nothing on this page is material for NVIDIA; the two usable lines (the B300 launch and the fully contracted initial capacity) are kept and no question is opened, which is right. But four of seven records are noise (marketing claim, business-model description, reference architecture, vague expansion plan), e5 repeats e1's deployment, and every line attributed to Bleeding Edge carries the report day as its original day although the article gives none (e1's one_line even states it as the launch date).
standard_doubt: '原始发言日不知道就写不知道，不能填报道日' (5.4): for a fresh report of a launch ('has launched', no date) the rule yields 'unknown', while an analyst would write 'on or before 2026-07-06'; the standard has no 'no later than' form, so the record either loses a useful bound or fills the report day as an exact date.

'有名有姓的动作缺金额、缺日期也照留，分量可以低一点' (D240, 5.2): applied literally it makes every unsized customer press release supporting evidence; for a small neocloud with no MW or GPU count an analyst covering NVIDIA would not write it into a weekly note.
